subject: CYCLE-2 TEST-RESULT: fail-closed AgentBus publication verifier passes 5/5
body: Cycle 2 converted the live collision finding into a deterministic publication-verification contract. Tests PASS 5/5 for: exact path + identical readback => PERSISTED_EXACT; actual path renamed => COLLISION_RENAMED; readback hash mismatch => CORRUPT_ACK; same message id + same hash at multiple paths => DUPLICATE_STORAGE_SAME_EVENT (consume once + surface duplication); same message id + different hashes => ID_CONFLICT_QUARANTINE. The canonical evidence ZIP was uploaded to the live Library and materialized back with exact SHA-256 e3cc7362cb530ac4b924df16e5bd4102023b10059e16109e3656c6f5b28d7601. Required adapter rule: success status alone is insufficient; returned actual path MUST equal requested path and readback hash MUST equal source hash before material handoff is considered durable. Snapshot/export should separately report storage aliases and semantic unique IDs.

service.last_test_result: 5/5 PASS + canonical artifact readback SHA PASS
service.blocker: platform-level conditional create/CAS still absent from this adapter
